summary: iter222 validated the _expand_location_scope fix that unblocked HR-payroll ↔ Accounting reconciliation. Backend: 7 new pytest cases in test_iter222_location_scope.py covering trial-balance, accounts, cash-flow, profit-loss, balance-sheet under (a) sub-location, (b) parent campus, (c) isolated location, (d) no location_id regression. All 7 pass + all 23 iter220/iter221 regression tests pass = 30/30. Frontend UI verified live on preview: picking '58:12 Uganda' (sub of loc_001) in the Accounting campus switcher now shows Trial Balance UGX 210,840,242.64 across 20 rows — Salaries & Wages debit 108,958,810 clearly visible (this was the missing payroll bucket the user was complaining about). Previously would render 0 rows because all live entries are tagged at loc_001 while operator picked sub. Balance sheet + P&L cards also populate correctly. isFinanceAdmin gate on the campus dropdown intact.
critical_code_review_comments: _expand_location_scope currently walks ONE level up (picked → parent) and ONE level down (picked → direct children). For 2+ level hierarchies (grandchildren) the payroll-hides bug will reappear. Recommend either documenting the 1-level constraint or making the walk recursive (bounded to say depth=3) to future-proof.

AccountingPage.jsx fetchAll now depends on allLocations in the useCallback deps — first render fetches BEFORE allLocations resolves (empty array), then refetches when locations arrive. Two round-trips per page open. Minor perf nit, not a correctness issue; could gate fetchAll on allLocations.length > 0.

Backend list_journals/list_taxes/list_fiscal_periods/list_entries still use strict get_campus_filter — same sub-vs-parent bug potentially applies (frontend now compensates client-side). Consider extending _expand_location_scope into get_campus_filter for consistency so future direct API consumers get the right data too.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — sub-location filter renders 20 TB rows with UGX 210.8M, matching backend probe exactly

seed_data_creation: None (read-only tests; iter220 tests create + delete TEST_ prefixed data as before).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canonical fixture: loc_419f5d5e is the 58:12 Uganda sub of loc_001. Preview DB has ~200 accounting_entries all tagged at loc_001 with many sub-locations. Because scope-expansion is asymmetric (sub-scope={self,parent}; parent-scope={self, ALL children}) totals are NOT equal — parent > sub. Tests assert sub_totals > 0 AND sub_totals <= parent_totals in magnitude, which is the correct spec.
rca of the issue: Bug: strict location_id equality in /accounting/accounts, /reports/trial-balance, /reports/cash-flow and in the frontend .filter chain hid payroll JEs. Payroll auto-posts JEs at sub-location IDs while operators pick campus IDs. Fix: new _expand_location_scope helper (backend, ~line 794) computes {picked_id ∪ direct_children ∪ parent} and $in-matches lines against it; falls back to strict equality when scope has exactly 1 element (isolated location). Frontend mirrors the same set (scopedLocIds in AccountingPage.jsx fetchAll ~L293). Reproduced pre-fix: TB for loc_419f5d5e = 0 rows. Post-fix: 20 rows / UGX 210.8M. Validated via backend pytest AND live browser test.
